mstts:express-as.prosody: As we wrap up, let’s take a moment to really soak in what this story means for all of us. Sometimes, survival asks us to make choices that push against everything we believe in. But even then, the connections we share—with friends, with our community—can carry us through times we never thought we’d survive. Healing isn’t quick or neat. It’s messy, and it takes patience, and a lot of forgiveness—especially toward ourselves. And yet, hope and faith, even when the world feels cold or unfair, have a way of pulling us forward. These lessons of resilience—they’re not just for people stranded on a mountainside. They’re for all of us, every single day. The Andes survivors’ journey isn’t just about what happened far away and long ago. It’s a reminder of the quiet strength that lives inside ordinary people, waiting for the moment it’s needed most. So, if you ever find yourself up against your own impossible mountain—whether it’s a real one or just something that feels that way—remember, you’re not alone. Lean on those around you. Trust in your own ability to keep going. And hold on to hope, even when the night feels endless. The road ahead won’t always be easy, but it’s always there. Let the story of these survivors light a spark for you—so you can face your own challenges with courage, with compassion, and with the unshakable belief that you, too, can make it through.
